import re
import sys

text = sys.stdin.read()
values = {}

pattern = re.compile(
    r"\b([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*<-\s*"
    r"(?:(\d+)|\(\s*([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*\+\s*(\d+)\s*\)\s*mod\s*(\d+))"
)

for match in pattern.finditer(text):
    variable, initial, source, increment, modulus = match.groups()
    if initial is not None:
        values[variable] = int(initial)
    else:
        values[variable] = (values[source] + int(increment)) % int(modulus)

print(f"a ?= {values['a']}; b ?= {values['b']}; TMP ?= {values['TMP']};")
